market.question: Will Synbetalib be FDA-approved for RA by December 31, 2022?
market.resolutionRules: Resolves YES if FDA approves Synbetalib for any RA indication on or before 2022-12-31 ET per Drugs@FDA or an official FDA press announcement. Resolves NO on CRL or missed deadline.

marketQuestion.resolutionDefinition: FDA approval of Synbetalib for any RA indication on or before the deadline.
